parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle of the bucket is a curved steel rod attached to the sides of the bucket, allowing it to be carried easily.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a means to lift and carry the bucket, supporting the weight of the contents.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around its attachment points to the bucket body, allowing it to swing freely for carrying or resting.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the bucket is a wooden cylindrical container with a slightly tapered shape.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and contains liquids or solids, forming the main storage volume of the bucket.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and rigid, serving as the structural component to which the handle is attached.
